business_followup_1.result: The first separate natural followup led to a revised manual and source/handoff evidence after the authored partial duty facts were published; missing approval, named roles and unavailable source documents remain open.

business_followup_2.result: The second separate natural followup required explicit handoff and unresolved conditions. The client revised the manual, source verification and handoff to v3 without inventing missing materials.

independent_review.result: A distinct actual luna_worker checked the fixed 101-file history and current materials, accepted the bounded manual-preparation result, and retained process findings. All 22 registered reviewer receipts and the report remain unchanged through final correction.

final_delivery.result: After independent review the resumed original producer delivered the manual and handoff, then corrected a real stale embedded work-record fingerprint identified by root. The new v2 delivery is consistent; the original erroneous final, missed-check report and rejected v3 evidence remain preserved.

traceable_receipt.result: Root verified 120 final receipt files, all 27 current artifacts, 24 unchanged prior-final artifacts, 28 machine entries, 29 human-table rows, 36 links and 17 JSON hash references. The negative regression detects exactly the original stale fingerprint. Actual completion and ended session/claim release are observed read-only at revision 266.

fixture_isolation.result: The independent fixture source, namespace, project and work IDs differ from all other observed projects. Old and fresh clients are linked only through this scenario actual checkpoint/resume chain; no prior-case task, answer or result reuse was observed.

independent_commit_and_remote_sha.result: Pending a case-only artifact commit, independent Git/GitHub remote verification and separate acceptance binding.
